modules.title: Data Privacy
modules.purpose: To train employees on Aurelle Hotels & Residences data privacy policies, ensuring guest and employee personal data is protected, accessed appropriately, and incidents are reported promptly.
key_concepts: Personal devices and messaging apps restriction
assessment_topics: Data Privacy and Information Security Compliance
modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete all checklists, practical tasks, scenarios, and achieve a passing score on the data privacy quiz.

content.text: Identify permitted access conditions for guest personal data and restrictions on personal devices and removable media.
Apply proper procedures for handling inquiries about guests and restricting access to employee personal files.
Recognize data incidents and execute the reporting timeline.

content.activity: Acknowledge restrictions on storing guest identity documents on personal mobile phones
Acknowledge mandatory reporting window for suspected loss or disclosure of guest data
Acknowledge restrictions against copying guest or employee personal data to USB drives or personal cloud storage

content.description: Review and verify compliance with data security controls regarding portable media and personal devices.
content.expected_outcome: Confirmation that no guest or employee personal data is copied to USB drives, personal cloud storage, or personal mobile phones.
content.completion_criteria: Employee verifies adherence to removable media and personal device handling prohibitions.

content.situation: A caller phones the maintenance workshop asking for the room number and confirmation of whether Mr. Smith is currently inside his guest room.
expected_actions: Refuse to disclose the room number or guest name.
Refuse to confirm the guest's presence.
Connect the call to the room without confirming presence.

options: Whenever an employee is curious about a VIP guest
To deliver the guest's stay or for a documented business need
Whenever a colleague requests it casually
Only during the check-in process by front desk staff
content.question: When is guest personal data permitted to be accessed?
content.explanation: Guest personal data may only be accessed to deliver the guest's stay or for a documented business need.

content.question: Guest identity documents may be photographed on a personal mobile phone if you need to send them to a supervisor quickly.
content.explanation: Guest identity documents must never be received, photographed or stored on personal mobile phones or messaging apps.

options: Provide the room number if the visitor describes the guest accurately
Check the system and tell them the room number
Refuse to disclose room numbers or guest names to callers or visitors
Call the guest room first and ask if they want to see the visitor
content.question: A visitor at the engineering desk asks for the room number of a registered guest. What should you do?
content.explanation: Room numbers and guest names must not be disclosed to callers or visitors; calls are to be connected to the room without confirming the guest's presence.

options: Only in the HR system, never in shared drives
In locked filing cabinets in the maintenance department
content.question: Where should employee personal files be stored?
content.explanation: Employee personal files must be accessed only by Human Resources and stored in the HR system, never in shared drives.

options: By the end of the work shift
content.question: Within what timeframe must any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data be reported?
content.explanation: Any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data must be reported to the Duty Manager and IT within 1 hour of discovery.

content.question: Guest or employee personal data can be copied to USB drives as long as it is password-protected.
content.explanation: Guest or employee personal data must not be copied to USB drives or personal cloud storage.

content.topic: Data Privacy and Information Security Compliance

rubric.criterion: Understanding data access limits and prohibitions on personal devices
rubric.pass_condition: Achieves full compliance in scenario and quiz questions related to data access and removable media.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly identifies purpose limitation rules and avoids using personal devices or USB drives for guest or employee data.

rubric.pass_condition: Correctly follows protocol in caller/visitor scenarios.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates strict adherence to non-disclosure of room numbers and guest presence to callers and visitors.

rubric.criterion: Data incident reporting and HR file security
rubric.pass_condition: Accurately answers incident response timelines and personnel file storage requirements.
rubric.expected_performance: Identifies the 1-hour reporting window for data breaches and recognizes HR-only access rules for personnel files.

modules.title: Engineering Safety
modules.purpose: To equip Maintenance Technicians with the essential safety procedures, PPE requirements, permit protocols, and maintenance service standards required at Aurelle Hotels & Residences.
key_concepts: Permit to Work and Hot Work Controls
modules.completion_criteria: Successful completion of all checklist items, practical tasks, scenarios, and achieving a passing grade on the quiz and assessment rubric.

content.text: Identify and apply proper PPE, chemical handling protocols, and maintenance workwear standards.
Comply with Lockout/Tagout, Permit to Work, hot work, and fire safety protocols.
Execute guest room maintenance response standards and complete weekly preventive maintenance tasks.

content.activity: Acknowledge engineering workwear standards in place of standard uniforms
Complete Chemical Handling training before first use of cleaning or pool chemicals
Complete Work Permit and Lockout/Tagout training before carrying out electrical or mechanical work

content.description: Execute weekly planned preventive maintenance tasks assigned in the maintenance system.
content.expected_outcome: All scheduled preventive maintenance tasks for the week are completed and logged correctly.
content.completion_criteria: Completion status verified in the maintenance system.

content.situation: You need to perform electrical maintenance inside a guest room, but upon arrival, you find the guest is currently checked in and occupying the room.
expected_actions: Verify that electrical work in guest rooms may only be carried out when the room is vacant.
Ensure the guest is moved to another room or the work is rescheduled before proceeding.

content.situation: You are about to perform maintenance on an industrial motor panel.
expected_actions: Isolate the energy source.
Apply your personal lock and tag.
Test for zero energy before starting work.

options: Engineering workwear and PPE required by HSP-01
content.question: What standard of clothing must Maintenance Technicians wear instead of the standard uniform?
content.explanation: Maintenance Technicians are exempt from the uniform standard in Section 4.1 and must instead wear the engineering workwear and PPE required by HSP-01.

content.question: What technique must supervisory and engineering staff demonstrate using a fire extinguisher during practical training?
content.explanation: Supervisory and engineering staff must demonstrate correct use of a fire extinguisher using the PASS technique during practical training.

options: Safety footwear, gloves and eye protection
Ear protection and high-vis vest only
Rubber apron and face shield only
content.question: Which items of protective equipment must be worn when handling cleaning chemicals or using power tools?
content.explanation: Safety footwear, gloves and eye protection must be worn when handling cleaning chemicals or using power tools.

options: Anytime during the day regardless of occupancy
Only when the room is vacant; if occupied, the guest must be moved or work rescheduled
Only while the guest is out for lunch
content.question: When must electrical work in guest rooms be carried out?
content.explanation: Electrical work in guest rooms may only be carried out when the room is vacant; if the room is occupied, the guest must be moved or the work rescheduled.

content.question: How long must a fire watch remain present after the completion of hot work such as welding, cutting, or grinding?
content.explanation: Hot work such as welding, cutting or grinding may only be performed by technicians holding a valid hot work certificate, with a fire watch present for 30 minutes after completion.

content.question: Within what timeframe must guest-room maintenance requests be acknowledged?
content.explanation: Guest-room maintenance requests must be acknowledged within 15 minutes and resolved, or the guest updated, within 2 hours.

rubric.pass_condition: Demonstrates 100% compliance with HSP-01 and COC-01 standards during assessment.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly identifies and wears designated engineering workwear and required PPE for chemical and tool handling.

rubric.pass_condition: Executes all isolation and permit steps without deviation.
rubric.expected_performance: Properly isolates energy sources, applies personal locks and tags, tests for zero energy, and secures required permits.

rubric.pass_condition: Successfully performs the PASS procedure during practical evaluation.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates correct use of a fire extinguisher using the PASS technique.

rubric.pass_condition: Meets response time and PM task completion metrics.
rubric.expected_performance: Follows guest room response timelines and completes assigned preventive maintenance tasks.

modules.completion_criteria: Successful completion of all Day 1 fire & life safety check items, passing the quiz with 100% mastery, and completing the finance three-way match task.

content.text: Identify and execute first-day fire and life safety orientation and evacuation procedures including the RACE protocol.
Understand ongoing fire safety drill participation requirements and company support guidelines.

content.activity: Complete fire and life safety orientation on Day 1
Locate the fire assembly point and the two nearest fire exits for your work area
Acknowledge and memorize the RACE procedure and prohibition of lifts during fire alarms
Participate in fire drills every six months
Complete the Aurelle Culture e-learning path within the first 30 days

content.description: Perform a verification check of a sample supplier invoice by matching it to the corresponding Purchase Order and goods received note.
content.expected_outcome: Accurately complete a three-way match validation ensuring proper documentation prior to payment.

content.situation: While working in the engineering workshop, you hear the fire alarm sound continuously. You remember your training on emergency protocols.
expected_actions: Follow the RACE procedure (Rescue, Alarm, Contain, Evacuate)
Avoid using the lifts under any circumstances
Proceed immediately to the designated fire assembly point

content.question: Fire and Life Safety orientation must be completed on your first day.
content.explanation: Fire and Life Safety orientation must be completed on Day 1 as specified in CMP-01 and FLS-01.

options: The names of all maintenance staff members
The location of the fire assembly point and the two nearest fire exits
The exact budget allocated for fire extinguishers
The phone number of the external fire chief
content.question: What should employees know regarding their specific work area for fire safety?
content.explanation: Employees must know the location of the fire assembly point and the two nearest fire exits for their work area.

options: Run, Alert, Call, Evacuate; use the service lifts
Rescue, Alarm, Contain, Evacuate; do not use the lifts
Read, Assess, Clear, Exit; use the main passenger lifts
Remove, Access, Control, Escape; do not use the stairs
content.question: What does the acronym RACE stand for, and what equipment must not be used during a fire alarm?
content.explanation: On hearing the fire alarm, employees must follow the RACE procedure (Rescue, Alarm, Contain, Evacuate) and must not use the lifts.

content.question: How often must all employees participate in a fire drill?
content.explanation: All employees must participate in a fire drill every six months.

options: Purchase Order, goods received note, and bank statement
Supplier invoice only, Purchase Order, and budget sheet
Purchase Order, goods received note, and supplier invoice
Goods received note, requisition slip, and check copy
content.question: What three elements must supplier invoices be matched to before payment?
content.explanation: Supplier invoices must be matched to the Purchase Order and the goods received note before payment.

options: Tell them pets are strictly prohibited anywhere on hotel grounds without exception
Allow the pet immediately without checking any documentation
Ask the guest to contact the local municipal animal shelter
content.question: A guest asks whether their pet dog is allowed to stay in their room during their extended hotel visit. What should you do if you are unsure?
content.explanation: If you are unsure whether a guest's pet can stay, check the Pet Policy (PET-01).

content.topic: Fire Safety Procedures and Finance Three-Way Matching

rubric.pass_condition: Answers all safety related questions correctly and demonstrates correct evacuation knowledge.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates full understanding of first-day orientation, workspace fire exits, assembly points, and the RACE procedure without using lifts.

rubric.pass_condition: Accurately completes the invoice verification task meeting company financial controls.
rubric.expected_performance: Successfully executes the three-way match by matching supplier invoices to the Purchase Order and goods received note.

content.question: What is the standard working time per week across Aurelle Hotels & Residences?
content.explanation: Standard working time is 48 hours per week across six shifts; overtime is required to be approved in advance by the department head.

content.question: Absence due to illness must be reported to your supervisor at least two hours before the start of your shift.
content.explanation: Absence due to illness must be reported to the supervisor at least two hours before the start of the shift.

content.question: How many calendar days of annual leave are employees entitled to per year?
content.explanation: Employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of annual leave per year, accrued monthly from the date of joining.

content.question: What is the maximum number of unused annual leave days that may be carried forward to the next year?
content.explanation: A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year; any excess days lapse on 31 March.

options: At least 14 days before the first day of leave

key_concepts: Pool hours and lifeguard duty requirements
modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete all checklist items, practical tasks, scenarios, and achieve a passing score on the quiz and assessment.

content.text: Apply safe manual handling techniques for heavy loads and adhere to pool operation, lifeguard certification, and water testing regulations.

content.activity: Acknowledge receipt and understanding of safe lifting procedures for heavy loads

expected_actions: Recognize that the pool must be closed to guests at any time a lifeguard is not on duty.
Instruct guests to exit the pool immediately.

content.question: What is the maximum weight a single employee is permitted to lift without assistance or a trolley?
content.explanation: Loads heavier than 20 kg must be lifted by two people or moved with a trolley.

content.question: At what time must the pool be closed to guests in the evening according to company policy?
content.explanation: The pool must be closed to guests at 20:00 and at any time a lifeguard is not on duty.

content.question: Employees assigned to pool duty may complete their lifeguard certification training during their first week of pool shifts.
content.explanation: Employees assigned to pool duty must hold a valid lifeguard certificate before their first pool shift.

content.question: How often must pool water chlorine and pH levels be tested and logged during opening hours?
content.explanation: Pool water chlorine and pH levels must be tested and logged every 4 hours during opening hours.

content.explanation: Any injury to a guest or employee must be reported to the Manager on Duty (MOD) within 15 minutes.
